g.text: centered-window
A Python probe plus a SoFplus addon that make a borderless windowed SoF sit in the middle of the Windows work area.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`install_center_window.bat` · runs the probe from the SoF folder, then `start SoF.exe`
`center_window.py` · the only thing that asks Windows where the taskbar is
`sofplus/addons/centered_window.func` · runs inside the game at map load
choose DPI mode · Win10 `SetProcessDpiAwareness(2)`, Win7 `SetProcessDPIAware`, any other release `sys.exit(1)`
read work area · `GetMonitorInfo(MonitorFromPoint(0,0))`, the bottom edge is the screen minus the taskbar
write once · create `sofplus/data/cw_work_area.cfg` only if the file does not exist
read both resolutions · split `_sp_cl_vid_mode_0` on `:` and `vid_mode_` + `gl_mode` on `x`
force borderless · if `_sp_cl_vid_border` is 1, set 0 and `vid_restart`
wait for the cfg · 1 s timer execs the file, and retries every second with an `echo` hint until `cw_res_desktop_y` is set
centre it · half desktop minus half game size, written to `vid_xpos` and `vid_ypos`
`sofplus/data/cw_work_area.cfg` · one `set` line, written once
`cw_res_desktop_x`, `cw_res_desktop_y`, `cw_res_sof_x`, `cw_res_sof_y` plus two tilde-prefixed scratch cvars · session only
Win32 · `GetMonitorInfo`, `MonitorFromPoint`, DPI shcore, the taskbar itself
SoF.exe · reads `vid_xpos` and `vid_ypos` when it creates the window
SoFplus scripting · `sp_sc_cvar_*`, `sp_sc_timer`, `sp_sc_flow_if`
without awareness the taskbar height is wrong
one integer, the work-area bottom
cvars only, no file
the restart must finish first
one more 1 ms timer
the bat runs the probe, the addon runs the maths
the probe leaves one number, the addon leaves cvars
Windows answers once, the game and SoFplus consume
